title: HOT-532 Add breakfast to quotes
body:
Adds breakfast to quotes.

- New optional `breakfast` flag on each room line, so an organiser can add breakfast for some rooms and not others.
- Breakfast is €18 per room per night and is included in the quote total.
- `GET /api/v1/quotes/{id}` returns the flag inside `rooms`, so the client can show it.

Old quotes have no flag and keep their price. Unit tests cover the total with and without breakfast.

Ticket: https://tracker.acme.test/browse/HOT-532
